title.narrative: Climate Resilience of Rural Households in the Dry Corridor

description.narrative: This action aims to enhance the adaptive capacities of regional and local actors in response to droughts and other climate risks as well as their impact on food security. It proposes to do so by improving smallholder farmers' access to information required for climate adaptation and implementing climate-smart agriculture technologies.
